title: Inventory from {pos}
summary: Admins: build each day's inventory from {pos} itself, so the daily upload becomes optional. Readiness, live stock and what still needs a file.

blocks.text: Instead of uploading a file every day, RetailOps can make the day's stock list from {pos} each night at 4:05 AM: counts, prices, barcodes and categories from {pos}, and 7, 30 and 90-day sales counted from the sales RetailOps has copied.

It is off until an admin selects **Use {pos} for inventory** on Setup › Inventory from {pos}. It applies at once, and every change is listed there with who and when. Until then, the nightly run only compares what it built with that day's file.

items: Each nightly comparison is scored. On hand must match the file on 99% of counted items, price and barcode on 99%, category on 100%, with at most 10 unexplained differences.
Seven good nights in a row means ready. Admins get one alert at 9 AM while it is still off.
A night that misses starts the count again, and the page says which night and why.
A file uploaded for a day always replaces {pos}'s stock list for that day.
{pos} has no cost, vendor code or last-received date, so those come from the latest file. Upload one now and then; the **Inventory upload due** alert reminds you after 7 days.
{pos} only says out of stock for anything at 0 or below, so those show 0, except on Negative inventory.

blocks.text: With it on, New order, Reorder Candidates and Fix Issues' Negative inventory and Refill from container use {pos}'s current count, at most 5 minutes old. Barcodes are re-checked every hour when {pos}'s menu changes.
